title: Pyramid Texts: oldest known Egyptian religious texts
summary: Spells for the dead king's afterlife were carved on the inner walls of pyramids at Saqqara. They are the earliest known body of Egyptian religious texts.
why: Among the oldest religious writings anywhere; ancestors of the Coffin Texts and the Book of the Dead.

notes.problem: Title drops 'known'; source: 'the earliest known corpus of ancient Egyptian religious texts'.
